text: APPROVE. Moving the `||` expressions into `IsRepoRoot` and `HasDistinctParent` removes two boolean-operator increments (16 → 14), and `!HasDistinctParent(dir, parent)` is logically identical to the original `IsNullOrEmpty(parent) || parent == dir` break condition. The `parent!` is needed now that the null-check flow analysis is gone, and the helpers' `string?` parameters fit the nullable context the code already appears to use.
